blends.name: Blend Season 6 Pass = Wu Coin
blends.desc:
🚨 SEASON 6 HOLDERS — TIME TO EVOLVE 🚨

You’ve completed your journey…
All commons are claimed ✅
Your role as a Season 6 Pass holder is now fading… 🎭

No more access to #pass races ❌
No more utility left in the pass ⚠️

SO WHAT NOW?

👉 You can keep it as a memory and for its art 🎨
or
💰 transform it into something more economical

⚔️ BLEND INTO A GENERAL WU COIN 🟡 with a 12 % chance to get a Soulful Duck Coin 🔘 instead 🎉⚔️

Turn something expired into something with future utility, value, and purpose 💥

🔥 THE MOVE IS SIMPLE

Blend SeasonSix Pass ➝ General Wu Coin or Soulful Duck Coin 

🦆 Don’t sit on the past…
Step into what’s coming.

blends.name: Aquilon Morikawa (Legendary Blend)
blends.desc:
💧👑  🪄 Claim the Water Lord — Aquilon Morikawa

All currents lead to this moment.

Aquilon Morikawa, master of the Water Element and leader of the Tidebound Clan;
gathered the river mages, current riders, and stream wizards under his command. 
Every water duck this season traces its path back to him.

Now the final step of the Hunt awaits.

🪄  Use The Coin of Arashi to blend this Legendary.
If you hold all the other Hunt NFTs, Aquilon Morikawa is the last piece needed to complete your journey.

🌊 Check your status on the website to confirm you hold all required NFTs.

Those who complete the Hunt will:
🏁 Enter the Final Duck Race, where all qualified hunters compete and every position earns guaranteed WAX prizes.
✨ Receive a Mythic NFT, minted only for those who finished the Hunt. Its final supply depends on the number of qualified hunters.

blends.name: Airo Sen Vashi (Low Mint - Rare)
blends.desc:
🪄💧 Airo Sen Vashi, The currents are ready.🪄

Born where rivers bend and chaos turns, this young Tidebound wizard doesn’t force the flow—he directs it. 
Aquilon Morikawa chose him for a reason, and now that choice is yours.

✨ Blend 3 Wu Coins to claim a low-mint Rare—a calm mind, a steady hand, and power that moves only when the water allows. 💧

blends.name: Sui Keeper (Low mint - common)
blends.desc:
💧✨ The flow closes. The moment is now. ✨💧
Blend Sui Keeper, the final Common of Season Six, using 1 Wu Coin + 1 Season 4 Common. This is the last step before the waters seal—one more blend, one more piece closer to the finals. Don’t hesitate when the river calls. Step into the flow and secure your place before the season ends.

blends.name: Enoko (Low mint - common)
blends.desc:
🔥🪄 Blending Enoko is a declaration, not a delay. 🪄 ✨🔥
Two Wu Coins unlock a low-mint Common Enoko, forged for the heat of upcoming Mint Battles.
With Enoko stepping into the flames, the Fire Clan grows stronger — standing beside his younger brother Hinoko under Varyon Morikawa’s banner.
Each blend sharpens the path forward as Season 6 edges closer to its final clash. 🔥🦆

blends.name: Tanjiro (Low mint - common)
blends.desc:
🌊 Blending Tanjiro Tidebender is not a payment, but a pledge. 🌊✨
A single Series 4 common and one General Wu Coin stand as proof of trust in the current, not the reward.
Those who blend now step into the flow of Quackingwaxx, helping shape what comes next as the waters move forward.
The tide remembers those who act with faith — and it always returns stronger. 🌊🦆

blends.name: Luma (Low mint- common)
blends.desc:
🪄💧 Awaken Luma 💧

Luma does not answer to noise or haste. She listens to still water, to stone and moss, to the land that teaches when to move and when to stay.

By blending a Series 4 Common with a General Wu Coin, another Series Six Common is finally here. Luma will soon be airdropped to Season 6 Pass holders, carrying the quiet soul of Quackingwaxx into the season ahead.

Move gently. Blend wisely. Let the quiet guide you.

blends.name: Kanji (Epic - Low Mint Blend)
blends.desc:
🔥Awaken the Epic Kanji🔥
From the heart of molten earth, Kanji of the Fire-Clan rises.
He is the one who dared to draw Yoganzan, the blade forged in living flame — a weapon no other duck could claim.

Fire did not consume him.
It chose him.

Kanji walks the line between stone and ash, wielding a wrath born from lava and lost souls. Each step forward is a challenge to fate itself.

🔥 Blend Kanji and embrace the fire.
Not all paths are meant to be safe.
Some are meant to burn through the dark.

blends.name: Shinsoku (Rare- Low Mint Blend)
blends.desc:
Starts at Wednesday 17:00 UTC time

🔥 Shinsoku Calls — Only for the Fastest Blenders ⚡🦆💨

To summon the Rare Ninja Duck Shinsoku — the wind-runner, the river-shadow, the whispering quack in the night — you’ll need:
➡️ 2 General Wu Coins
➡️ 1 Series 1 Rare

Blend them… and claim a low-mint warrior who moves with impossible speed, slipping through mist and moonlight like a living ripple. 🌙🌫️🌊

Shinsoku carries warnings on the wind, disappears with a single splash, and leaves behind nothing but an echo. He rides the currents, flows through rivers and streams, and bends even tempests to the path he chooses. ⚡🌪️

Unlock him now and take one step closer to becoming a Season 6 Finalist.
Move fast — or you’ll only hear him passing by. 💨🦆🔥

blends.name: Roku Enkai + Break Man = General Wu Coin
blends.desc:
🔥✨ Exclusive Blend Time! ✨🔥
Use your Roku Enkai and Break Man promo NFTs to forge the General Wu Coin NFT 🪄🔥💰
Why blend?
Because these Wu Coins will be needed for future blends of Rare, Epic and Legendary NFTs — and early blenders get the rarest numbers. 🦆💎🔥
Don’t wait.
Turn your promos feathers into powder and secure the upcoming rare-ducks low mint blends! 🪄💰🔥

blends.name: Minato Hoshizora  (low mint - Blend)
blends.desc:
🌊 The Tide Awakens... 🌊

Quackers, prepare your Soulful Duck Coins — the waves are calling! 💧

Minato Hoshizora, The Tide Enforcer of Quackingwaxx, now rises from the deep!
Forged by storm and sea, his power surges through the battlefield — calm as a river, furious as the tide! ⚡🌊

Through alchemy and spirit, one must offer 1 Soulful Duck Coin to awaken his liquid wrath. 💠

🔥 Where fire ducks blaze, his waters strike back.
⚔️ Where storms rage, his will stands unbowed.
💎 Only the devoted can wield his strength — the Epic Water Duck

💦 Blend wisely, for Minato Hoshizora flows only once every storm.
Let the tides decide your fate... 🌊✨

blends.name: Burakkusumisu (Rare - Low mint Blend)
blends.desc:
🔥 Burakkusumisu Blend  🪄 🪄 🪄

The forge roars once more, quackers — and this time, it’s no ordinary flame. ⚒️
Burakkusumisu, the Fire Forge Master, awakens only for those brave enough to withstand the heat. Every swing of his hammer shapes destiny itself — and only through 3 General Wu Coins can his essence be summoned.

These blades aren’t born of steel, but of fire, spirit, and duck-born zeal. Each strike, each ember, carries the legacy of Quackingwaxx’s ancient smiths.

⚡ This is an elite low-mint blend.

🔥 Step into the flames. Shape your legend. Summon Burakkusumisu. 🦆⚔️

blends.name: Theron Blaze (Super Rare)
blends.desc:
🧙‍♂️  Wizard’s Challenge

The scroll whispers:

“To summon the flame, one must sacrifice silver and bronze alike…”

Only the wise know that Thenor Blaze 🔥 is forged, not found. 🔮
Use 1 Silver (Soulful Duck) and 1 Bronze (Wu Coin) to call his fiery essence from the ether.
But beware — this ritual is no trinket trade… it’s a test of will.

🔥✨ Let your blend burn bright — and summon the fireborn. ✨🔥

blends.name: Mizuki (common) Blend
blends.desc:
DISCOUNT blend;  🪄 
A wizard on the water and a master of the sea, Miss Mizuki dreamt of brighter days yet to be.
🌊 Mizuki would tell you — don’t sleep on this low mint blend!
For just 1 Wu Coin, you can craft your way to greatness. 🔥🚀

This is your chance to grab it early and maybe even snag Mint #1. ✨🦆

blends.name: Hinoko (common - low mint blend)
blends.desc:
🔥 The path of flame awaits! 🔥
Hinoko’s spark is ready to be ignited — all it takes is 1 General Wu Coin and 1 Series 2 Common to unlock this warrior.

Every ember starts small, but with the right blend, it becomes a fire no storm can put out. Will you light the way forward? ⚔️🔥

Blend now, and let Hinoko’s fire join your ranks!

blends.name: Fireblade (Rare s6)
blends.desc:
🔥 The Fireblade Rises! ⚔️🦆

In the valley where stone cracked under summer’s heat, a warrior strode into the blaze — the Fireblade. 🌋 With each strike he bent the flames to his will, turning ruin into radiant light. Sparks became his wings, and the fire itself bowed to his command.

⚡ Now YOU can claim the Rare Fireblade NFT through tomorrow’s low-mint blend at 17:00 UTC!

But beware, quackers — the fire tests the worthy. 💥 It will cost 3 Wu Coins 🪙🪙🪙, and every coin matters this season. Will you take the risk and seize the flame, or save your strength for rarer powers ahead?

🔥 Step forward. Bend the fire. Claim your place.

blends.name: Wu Coin = 3 X Roku Enkai promo
blends.desc:
🌀 Prepare for higher rarity ninja ducks by getting more Wu Coins...

3 X Roku Enkai promo blend  —🎭🎉🪄

⚔️ Blending high Rarity ninja ducks with Wu Coins instead of buying them with Wax, from the drop, increases your chances to get very low mint ninja ducks that are making you stronger for the Mint Battles.

blends.name: Toyo and Panpan (Legendary s5)
blends.desc:
🎴 ** The Final Task Has Arrived…** 🦆⚡
The time has come to complete your Season 5 journey.
Use your Coin of Arashi to blend for Toyo & Panpan – Legendary Ducks of the Season! 🌀

Recruiting them completes your Season 5 Set…
…and qualifies you for the epic Final Duck-Race — if you also meet the other requirements 🧐

✅ To qualify, you must also hold older NFTs of specific rarities and quantities.
Check your eligibility anytime at https://www.quackingwaxx.com/#nfthunt – just type your wallet into the NFT Tracker.

🔥 What’s at stake?
🏆 2400 WAX Prize Pool
🥇 1 Winner earns 800 WAX, a Mythic NFT, and their own Epic Duck
🎁 All other finalists split 1600 WAX equally and get a Mythic NFT

*Blend bravely. The feathers of fate await.*

blends.name: Lord Kaidou (Epic s5)
blends.desc:
⚔️🪙. They stole his gold. They buried his name. But vengeance doesn’t fade...
From the depths of silence,
A shadow rises draped in royal silk and rage.
He is not a myth.
He is not a memory.
He is Lord Kaidou — and he makes them pay in blood 🩸

To summon him, you’ll need just 1 Soulful Duck Coin 🪙.
🔁 Blend it with purpose.
Because this isn’t just a mint —

🎴 Low mint. High consequence. The road to justice is sharp and narrow...
Will you walk it? 👁🔥

blends.name: Ariovistus (common s5)
blends.desc:
🪄 Blend 2 General Wu Coins – Unleash Ariovistus 🦆⚓
Down by the docks, where secrets ride the tide and danger whispers with the wind—Ariovistus waits.
He’s not just a sailor… he’s a shadow, a smuggler, a storm in feathers. 🌀
Blend now to summon the duck who sails where others sink, and fights with the silence of legends.
No heroes here—only those bold enough to claim him.

Dare the dockside deal. Blend for Ariovistus. ✨

blends.name: The Merchant of Shadows (Epic s5)
blends.desc:
🕰 The Merchant of Shadows
Epic Shadow Eminence

He schemes from a distance— no first name, no trail left behind.
No criticism is printed. No secret is revealed.
Only whispers echo, deals tighten, and rivals fall silent.

He is the mind behind the plot.
A creator of Rare Ducks—Lapidarius, Labienus, Akakios.
Not out of loyalty, but as tools in a greater scheme.
A conspiracy to bring down Shadow Feathers and Arashi Wu.

🗡️ Precision. 💰 Influence. 🦆 Legacy.

💎 Low mint blend
🪙🪄 Blend 1 Soulfulduck Coin to summon him.

blends.name: Labienus (Rare s5)
blends.desc:
⚔️🔥 The Labienus Blend! 🪄
Steel nerves. Sharp mind. Ruthless deals.
Labienus doesn’t forge weapons — he moves them. 💼⚔️
If you want this Rare duck, you better act fast. Only the bold will claim this shadow trader. 🦆💰
Blend now and secure one of the lowest mints in the black market of ducks. 🧪✨
➡️ 3 Wu Coins for a shot at greatness.
🕰️ Time is ticking. Don’t miss it.

blends.name: Dravenius (Super Rare S5)
blends.desc:
Dravenius, the wizard, awaits those who dare to wield his power! This Super Rare NFT is blend-only, and it takes 1 Soulful Duck Coin to summon him.

Will you rise to the challenge? Collect 5 General Wu Coins, blend them into 1 Soulful Duck Coin, and unlock the magic of Dravenius!

Your journey to greatness is in your hands. Blend wisely, and let the power of the arcane flow through your collection! 🔮🔥

blends.name: Arashi Wu (Legendary s4)
blends.desc:
✨ He is here... Arashi Wu! ✨

The brand-new legend of Quackingwaxx, Arashi Wu, has arrived! As the long-lost son of the late General Wu, his legendary status seems almost destined—though it’s not just the name that got him here. The creation of the Coin of Arashi took monumental effort, symbolizing his rise and ambition.

If you’ve been collecting and blending all season, this is the last NFT you’ll need to qualify for the Final Duck-Race 🏁. The blend is your chance to secure Arashi Wu and complete your journey to the grand finale.

📅 Blend goes live tomorrow at 16:00 UTC, and the deadline to blend and qualify is Sunday 15th December at 20:00 UTC. Don’t miss out!

blends.name: The Coin of Arashi = 2 X Soulful Duck Coins
blends.desc:
🔥 🪄  Blend Alert: The Coin of Arashi 🟡 *(gold coin)*

✨Blend now to secure this powerful coin. 💰

A new era gold coin that boosts the Quackingwaxx economy's efficiency. 💎🚀

blends.name: Kintaro (Super Rare S4)
blends.desc:
🎋⛩️One day, a warrior arrived, seeking a blade unlike any other. He was a quiet man, with eyes that spoke of battles fought and burdens carried. Kintaro listened to the warrior's story and set to work. As sparks flew and the hammer sang, the sword took shape, delicate yet deadly, reflecting the warrior's inner strength and quiet resolve.

When the blade was complete, Kintaro inscribed a haiku that told the warrior's untold story: 🗡️  🪄

_"A silent river,  
Flows deep with unseen power,  
Strength in still waters."_

Hiroshi accepted the blade with a bow, knowing that it was not just a weapon, but a testament to his life's journey. As he departed, the villagers marvelled at the wisdom of the blacksmith duck, whose enchanted forge in Quackingwaxx continued to shape not only steel but also the destinies of those who sought his craft. 🔥🧙

blends.name: Akhiru Ryuu (Legendary series3)
blends.desc:
🌊🐍 Dive into the legend of Akhiru Ryuu, the Beast Master! Blend now and unlock the power of water and serpent! 🌊🐍

In a mystical aquatic terrain, Akhiru Ryuu transformed and gained mastery over the titanic serpent, guiding his fellow ninja ducks to liberation. 🦆💪

🌀💧 Blend your NFTs and become part of the legend! The serpent awaits... Will you seize control? 🪄

Blend today and secure your place in QuackingWaxx history! 🏆✨
